name: site-footer
title: Site Footer
author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
description: Brand, standfirst, two to four link columns, legal line. Variants: columns, minimal.
docs: Deliberately not a Section: a footer sits outside the band rhythm and takes its own padding. `minimal` is a real variant rather than `columns: []`, so an empty grid is never the way to ask for the short shape.
